rows: Office timings: 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM, with ±30 minutes flexibility.
Employees are required to complete 8 working hours per day, including a 30-minute lunch break.

Lunch break: 1:00 PM to 1:30 PM, unless the employee is attending a client meeting or is on 
a site visit.
If an employee is required to work late at the office, prior approval is required for overtime
Public Holidays: As per the company's annual holiday calendar.

If an employee takes leave immediately before and after a weekly off or public holiday, the
intervening weekly off/public holiday will also be counted as leave.

For example, if an employee takes leave on Saturday and Monday, then Sunday will also 
be counted as leave.
Planned leave must be requested at least 7 working day in advance.

In case of emergency or medical leave, the employee must inform the office as soon as possible. 
Leave is subject to approval based on project and work requirements.
Leave amounts will be deducted from the monthly salary.

The deducted leave amount will be reimbursed every 6 months, in January and July, subject 
to the applicable leave balance.

Travel by train or bus will not be counted as overtime. Only regular working hours will be 
considered for such travel days.
Only site visits conducted after regular working hours will be counted as overtime.

All employees are required to serve a 30-day notice period before leaving the company, unless 
otherwise decided by the company.
Salary payout date: 7th of every month.
